■ Stage Direction
Age: Early 30s
Personality: Kind
---
★ Request
Winning Ticket runs and exits frame

★ Request
Fade to black

★ Request
Winning Ticket runs in and enters frame

To achieve that, should I teach Winning Ticket how to feign weakness
and catch opponents off guard, as they suggested?
...She always gives it everything she's got. I want to help her win more, somehow.

Huh, really!? That's... great, that's so great!
Hurraaaayyyyy!!
There were days soaked in tears—or rather, drowning in them.

For my precious, most cherished partner...
What can I possibly dooooo...!!

Whoaaa!? Trainer, you've completely, totally revived...!!
Waaahh, I'm so glad, waaaahhh~!!

Alright then, let's talk about the next routine!
I'll listen to everything you say with all my might!!

Winning Ticket was as excessively intense as ever,
so I hurriedly instructed her on the training menu.

Yet seeing her think so desperately and with "all her might" just like usual—
I was struck by sudden realization.

I had been pondering what was said earlier so deeply
that I ended up making Winning Ticket worry about me...

—Hey there, good work.
Your trainee is as energetic as the rumors say.

GOOOOOOAAAAL!!
Winning Ticket takes FIRST PLAAAAACEEE!!!

Did you see my full-power grand victoryyyy!
I grabbed glory, Trainer!!

In short, her vibe fires up her rivals.
They think, 'What incredible power! Damn it, I won't lose!'

No, rather... I see.
She's just too obvious, isn't she?

Hiding your sharp edge and making opponents drop their guard—
that's an important tactic on the turf as well, wouldn't you say?

Oops, my bad. I've said too much to a rival trainer.
Well, don't worry about it too much. ...Excuse me, then.
Nnngggghhhhhh... gnnuuuurrrggghhh...!!

Allllright!! Time for even more, more, moooore full-power training!!
First, a lap around the perimeter—no, around all of Japan...!!
Lately, Winning Ticket has been totally fired up about mock races.

Got it, thank you!!
Alright, I'm heading out for distance runs right away!

Trainer, I'm sorry!!
I need to train way, way harder, don't I...?!!

Wait, what are you pondering? What is it, what is it!?
I'll think with you! Like, nnngggghhhhhh!!

You're watching over me properly! You're thinking for me!
That's why I—believe in you!

Seeing the deep trust shining in her eyes once more...
I resolved to face her with even greater sincerity.

Ugh... *sniff*... WAAAAAAHHHH!!
I'm so frusssstrated!! Time to train from scratch!!

As long as I'm with you, absolutely, without a doubt!
I can run forward, forward, with all my might!!

Right, right. But... looking at her mock race results,
it seems she still has some instability.
Turn frustration into fuel! Next stop, the Derbbbyyyyy!

Nnngggghhhhhh...
What could Trainer be agonizing oveeeerrr...!!
Some days were radiant with smiles—

And so, wins and losses came in turns or streaks.
Now then, today's mock race result is—

WAAAAAAHHHH!!
I loooossstttt!!

...Huh? Trainer?
Huhhh? You look... oddly refreshed?

...ner! Trainer!? Did your soul just leave your body...!?
This is bad... Traaaiiineeeerrrr!!
I... I lost... me...
